# Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent sample

> **Status: coming soon, illustrative only.** MCP support in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit is
> in preview, and its manifest formats are still changing. Treat these files as a starting
> point. Generate a fresh project with the toolkit (**Add action → Start with an MCP server**)
> and copy the ZiplineOS-specific values (name, description, instructions, server URL) across,
> rather than using these files as they are.

<!-- TODO(liam): validate these manifests against a project generated by the current Agents
Toolkit before publishing; update schema versions and the runtime/auth block to match. -->

## Files

- `appPackage/declarativeAgent.json`: the agent's name, description and instructions. The
  instructions are read from `instruction.txt`.
- `appPackage/ai-plugin.json`: the action that points at the ZiplineOS MCP server.
- `appPackage/instruction.txt`: a copy of [../agent-instructions.md](../agent-instructions.md).
  Keep them identical. CI checks this.

## Values to set

- `${{ZIPLINEOS_OAUTH_REFERENCE_ID}}`: the OAuth registration ID the toolkit creates when you
  enter the client ID and secret generated in ZiplineOS (see
  [clients/microsoft-copilot.md](../../clients/microsoft-copilot.md)).
